LSU New Orleans APPS & Textbooks
MyApps Portal
This portal provides access to all of your LSU New Orleans cloud apps such as Outlook, Workday, Canvas, Gitlab, and more from one location. These apps can be accessed through the internet without the need of downloading software.
Apps for CSCI Students:
Calendar
schedule or view meetings with other LSU New Orleans students and faculty.
CSCI AutoLab
submit and grades your computer science labs
CSCI Gitlab
online repository for computer science software projects
CSCI Web Terminal
web client to your Java developer environment
Email
web client for your LSU New Orleans email
Handshake
connects students to job offers
Canvas
web access to your course materials
Office 365 Suite
web access to Microsoft Office: Excel, Powerpoint, Word, OneNote
LSU New Orleans Software Store
student pricing for commercial software suites
Virtual Desktop
web access to your on-campus account of WIndows 10
Zoom
web access to LSU New Orleans zoom video conferencing software
MyApps Portal
myapps.uno.edu
Follett Access
Students are automatically charged a $25/crh fee to gain access to their books for all of their classes. This fee can be paid with financial aid and scholarship money, so you don’t have to pay out of pocket for your books! This is done through Brytewave and LSU New Orleans bookstore. If you are unable to access a text for a class for any reason, you can go to the bookstore for more information. Students are able to opt out of the program, and can do so on the website. However, any student who opts out will have to pay out of pocket for all of their textbooks. Each opt out is only available for one semester at a time. This means, if you want to opt out, you have to do so each semester.
Follett Access
uno.edu/follett-access
Advising & Counseling Services
Counseling Services
Mental and emotional wellness are crucial to your academic success! If you are experiencing any challenges that you’d like to discuss with a counselor, whether personal or academic, please reach out to Counseling Services. Counseling Services can also help you build academic skills like stress-management, time-management, transitioning to college, communication, and they can even help you learn to manage your test-anxiety. Evaluations are free while you’re a student at LSU New Orleans, but they can be quite expensive once you graduate, so it’s always worth calling for a free assessment.
Hours
M-F 8am-4:30pm.
Counseling Services
226 University Center
Phone: 504-280-6683
uno.edu/counseling-services
HUB
The HUB is part of our student support team at LSU New Orleans. The HUB provides intentional support in a broad range of areas including academic, financial, social, emotional, and physical wellness. You can schedule an appointment with a care coordinator to learn more about how the HUB can help you.
Hours
M-F 8am-4:30pm.
HUB
252 University Center
Phone: 504-280-6227
Email: [email protected]
uno.edu/hub
Administrative Services
Bursar
If you have any issues paying your bill, need to set up a payment plan, or need to have a transcript hold removed from your account after paying down your balance, you need to contact the Bursar’s office. You can also find a breakdown of your tuition and fees per credit hour on the Bursar website.
Hours
M-F 8am-4:30pm.
Bursar
PEC in Library
Phone: 504-280-6489
Email: [email protected]
uno.edu/bursar
Disability Services
If you received accommodations in high school, you MIGHT qualify for accommodations here. There are many differences in federal law that govern what accommodations must be offered in K-12 vs. college. You MUST submit a disability documentation packet to find out what accommodations you may qualify for. It is up to you which faculty members you share your disability information with, however it is generally a good idea to speak with your academic advisor about any disabilities in order to ensure you get the schedule and have access to any additional resources you may need.
Hours
M-F 8am-4:30pm.
Disability Services
Library, Room 126E
Phone: 504-280-7327
Email: [email protected]
uno.edu/disability-services
International Student Services
Whether you’re an international student or a student looking to study abroad, the International Center is here to assist you. It’s a great place to study, meet new friends, and learn about other cultures. It’s also a great place to practice your foreign language speaking skills.
Hours
M-F 8am-4:30pm.
International Students
International Center
Phone: 504-280-3248
uno.edu/international-center
Computer Labs and Libraries
The Department of Computer Science has many computational resources available to students. Our computer classrooms/labs have been used for courses at all levels.
Computer Labs
The department has five computer classrooms/labs available for student and faculty use. The labs are all located in Math Building, in rooms 322, 320, 317, 212, 209. For more info, see Computer Science facilities.
Study Rooms
The department has a study room available for student and faculty use equipped with a ten person conference table and wall-mounted display using HDMI connection. The study room is located in Math Building, in room 318.
LSU New Orleans Library
The LSU New Orleans Library has nearly one million volumes, as well as numerous journal and ejournal holdings.
